name: Vadym Pyrozhenko
title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Professional
hero_summary: IT professional with over 12 years of experience, including more than 7 years in DevOps and cloud infrastructure engineering. Experienced in designing, automating and maintaining production environments, improving CI/CD processes and supporting reliable enterprise platforms. Combines hands-on infrastructure expertise with technical coordination and team leadership experience.
pdf_summary: IT infrastructure and DevOps professional with 12+ years in IT, including 7+ years in DevOps and cloud infrastructure. Experience spans AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and production reliability. Previously led systems administration teams and coordinated enterprise infrastructure work. Combines hands-on automation and troubleshooting with cross-functional collaboration, technical documentation and release support across enterprise IT and financial services and business-critical production environments.
about: I am a DevOps and cloud infrastructure professional with more than 12 years of experience in IT, including over 7 years in DevOps, infrastructure automation and production environments. My background connects traditional systems administration with cloud engineering, container orchestration and operational reliability.

My professional experience spans multiple industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Retail & E-commerce, Telecommunications, Healthcare, and Blockchain.

I have contributed to enterprise-scale technology projects, supporting business-critical platforms, cloud infrastructure modernization, system reliability, and infrastructure automation across diverse operational environments.

Before specializing in DevOps, I led systems administration engineers and coordinated infrastructure work with vendors and contractors. That experience informs how I approach capacity planning, documentation, service continuity and the practical needs of the teams who run and use infrastructure.
